config.label: Transport to run
config.description: Transport to run. Defaults to stdio. Set to http to expose a streamable HTTP endpoint instead.

config.label: Host to bind when ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT=http
config.description: Host to bind when ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

config.label: Port to bind when ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT=http
config.description: Port to bind when ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

config.label: Allowed CORS origin for the HTTP transport
config.description: Allowed CORS origin for the HTTP transport. Defaults to the bound host:port.
